hdbSource.name: HDB Existing Building — Housing & Development Board

regionSource.name: Master Plan 2025 Region Boundary (No Sea) — Urban Redevelopment Authority
regionSource.coverage: Master Plan 2025; source data from December 2025

propertyInformationSource.name: HDB Property Information — Housing & Development Board
propertyInformationSource.joinMethod: Property Information is joined only by exact normalized block number and a street uniquely resolved for every HDB footprint using its source ST_COD. Ambiguous or incomplete street codes are not joined.

metadata.license: Singapore Open Data Licence; see source pages for current terms.
metadata.crsAssumption: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (RFC 7946), inferred from GeoJSON coordinates and Singapore bounds; neither source declares a CRS.
metadata.assignmentMethod: Each valid HDB footprint is assigned to the single region polygon that covers its Shapely representative point. Footprint geometry is not modified. Records without exactly one matching region are omitted and counted.
